Terms of Service

The terms for using AutoPromote, your account and your content.

Effective date: 23 November 2026 · Last updated: 23 November 2026

1. Agreement and eligibility

These Terms govern your use of AutoPromote's website, application and related services. By using the Service, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the Service. Contact AutoPromote at thulani@autopromote.org with questions.

You must have authority to agree to these Terms and meet the age and eligibility requirements of the services and social platforms you connect. If you act for an organisation, you must be authorised to act on its behalf.

2. What the Service provides

AutoPromote provides tools for creating and editing media, AI-assisted workflows, finding and preparing clips, combining recordings, and publishing, scheduling and reviewing content on supported connected platforms. Availability depends on your plan, credits, permissions, supported formats and the current feature configuration.

Processing times, third-party availability and publishing outcomes can vary. A queued job or accepted upload is not confirmation that a platform has published your content. We do not guarantee particular audience growth, engagement, revenue or uninterrupted availability.

3. Accounts and workspaces

Provide accurate account information, protect your sign-in credentials and notify us promptly if you suspect unauthorised access. Only connect accounts and upload media you are authorised to use.

Workspace owners and administrators are responsible for the invitations, roles, shared materials and publishing permissions they grant. Review a workspace's access before sharing personal media or connected destinations with it.

4. Your content and permissions

You retain your rights in the content you upload or create. You give AutoPromote a non-exclusive permission to store, copy, process, transform and transmit that content as needed to provide the features you request, including rendering, collaboration and publishing according to your instructions. This permission does not transfer ownership of your content to AutoPromote.

You are responsible for having the necessary rights and permissions for footage, music, artwork, voices, likenesses and other material you use. Review the licences and consent requirements that apply to source material and generated outputs.

5. Connected platforms and publishing

Connecting a platform grants access within the permissions you approve. Publishing, scheduling and other enabled actions use those permissions and your selected settings. Review the media, destination, visibility, timing and disclosures before submitting. Disconnecting a platform does not remove posts already published there.

You must comply with each connected platform's terms, music and content rules, including applicable commercial and AI-content disclosures. The platform may apply additional labels, reject content, impose limits or change its APIs.

AutoPromote uses YouTube API Services. By using AutoPromote's YouTube features, you also agree to be bound by the YouTube Terms of Service.

6. AI-assisted features and review

AI-generated suggestions, captions, translations, analysis and media can contain errors or produce unexpected results. Review the finished picture, sound, wording and rights before sharing or relying on an output. AI assistance does not guarantee accuracy, originality, clearance of third-party rights or suitability for a particular purpose.

7. Plans, credits and payments

Prices, included allowances, processing-credit costs and any recurring billing terms are shown with the relevant offer or checkout. Review those details before purchasing or starting a paid operation. Payment processing is handled by the provider shown at checkout, such as PayPal; AutoPromote does not store full payment card numbers.

For a subscription, review its renewal and cancellation options in Billing or with the payment provider. Contact thulani@autopromote.org about billing errors, cancellation difficulties or refund requests. Any advertised refund terms and rights required by applicable consumer law continue to apply.

You must not use the Service to:

  • Break the law, infringe intellectual-property or privacy rights, or publish material without necessary permissions.
  • Impersonate people deceptively, distribute unlawful or abusive content, send spam, or evade required platform disclosures.
  • Introduce malware, obtain unauthorised access, interfere with other users, or bypass security, account allowances or payment controls.

9. Availability, storage and ending access

Keep backups of important originals and finished work. Some editable projects are stored in your browser, and some processing files and download links are temporary. Follow any expiry shown in the product; clearing browser data can remove local projects.

We may restrict or suspend access when needed to address security risks, unlawful activity, non-payment or a breach of these Terms. Where appropriate, we will provide notice and an opportunity to resolve the issue. You can stop using the Service and request account or data deletion by emailing thulani@autopromote.org. Billing cancellation, data deletion and removal of content from third-party platforms are separate actions.

The Service is provided on an as-available basis. To the extent permitted by applicable law, AutoPromote disclaims implied warranties and is not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from use of the Service, including losses caused by third-party outages or platform decisions.

Nothing in these Terms excludes liability or limits consumer, privacy or other rights that cannot lawfully be excluded. Disputes remain subject to the applicable law and courts with jurisdiction. Contact us first so we can try to resolve a concern.

Our Privacy Policy explains the information we process, why we use it and how you can contact us about your rights. We may update these Terms and will identify the new effective date on this page.
